Projects

Offshore Aquaculture Net Pens

Mechanical Design Structural Analysis Hydrostatic & Hydrodynamic Analysis Design for Manufacturing Systems Integration

Development of open-ocean aquaculture net pen systems designed to support fish stocks exceeding 100,000, enabling large-scale, sustainable seafood production.

Underwater Biomass Estimation Camera

Mechanical Design Electronics Packaging Thermal Management Pressure Vessel Design Project Management

The BMC V2 is an ML-powered subsea camera system that helps aquaculture farm operators estimate fish biomass in real time, reducing feed costs and improving harvest planning. As mechanical lead on a 20+ person cross-functional team, I owned the electronics packaging architecture, thermal management for continuous subsea operation, sub-millimeter tolerance stack-ups for the optical components, and all design analysis, product testing, and validation. The system launched to production in 2026 at $2.5M ARR.

Washdown Power Supply Enclosure

Enclosure Design Electronics Packaging Waterproofing & Sealing Rapid Prototyping Embedded Systems

An IP68-rated edge computing enclosure designed to extend the BMC V1 camera system to remote aquaculture farm sites. The enclosure houses onboard compute and networking hardware built to survive outdoor marine environments. Once deployed at a farm, it connects directly to the subsea camera feed and pushes processed biomass data to the cloud, giving operators remote access without manual data transfer.

U.S. Navy Vessel Strength Analysis

Finite Element Analysis (FEA) Structural Analysis Nonlinear Analysis Regulatory Compliance Workflow Automation

Structural FEA for U.S. Navy and commercial vessels using Nastran and FEMAP. I built full-scale finite element models and detailed sub-models from structural drawings, applied hydrostatic and dynamic loads, and validated results against naval codes and regulatory standards. One of the more complex programs was the EPF-13 Expeditionary Fast Transport, where I developed structural reinforcements to meet manufacturing and code requirements. I also built VBA scripts to automate model setup and post-processing workflows across the team.

Aquaculture Net Pen Mortality Extraction System

Mechanical Design Structural Analysis Design for Manufacturing Field Deployment & Commissioning Customer-Driven Iteration

A subsea mechanical system designed to automate the removal of deceased fish from open-ocean net pens, improving operational efficiency and enhancing farm operator safety.
